stage: fast loop (parameter selection BEFORE the full render) + the honest b2-flicker iteration that followed
window: b8p3.mp4 first 300 frames (--max-frames 300), one source cut at frame 189; the b2 iteration stage ran on the full 225-frame close-up (the cell that failed)

b8-300.recipe: the recorded w4b/W2C b8-first300 derived-reference class (ffmpeg -frames:v 300 -t 12 -crf 20 ... -c:a copy); byte-reproduces the w4b-recorded sha

method: all renders via the FROZEN render.py CLI (fast loop) / render.render adapter (isolation A/B harness, same code path); between variants ONLY the INK_MANGA config values in spe/renderers.py were edited; the winning config is frozen verbatim in the shipped row

phases.phase: 2 — b2 flicker root-cause (isolation A/B on the failing cell, full 225-frame close-up)
phases.driftMeasurement: tone |delta| between consecutive frames in the G-T4 static selection (input flow < 0.15 px/frame) of b2: mean 2.18 gray levels, p90 6.0, p99 16.0, max 74 - the 'static' selection carries REAL sub-gate content drift (slow pan + crowd shimmer), so every hard threshold in the pipeline converts drift into 255-level swings at boundaries; sensor-noise models do not apply

variants.finding: the XDoG line burn is the dominant flicker source (+0.4%)
coarse density ladders make REGIONAL flips worse - rejected
soft-band gain reduction alone does not fix it (drift, not speckle)
narrowing the soft band helps a little; adopted

variants.label: binary median-stabilized line strokes + soft density knees (no hard classes) + eps 0.0015 + bilateral x2(d9,s60)

variants.note: soft dots WITHOUT the heavy bilateral
variants.finding: soft dots alone do not fix b2 - the cartoon-class smoothing is required

variants.label: FINAL: V7b + soft-dot ramp window 0.25 with exact saturation clamps

phases.visualArbitration: full-resolution VLM strip (original | v4 | V7a | V8a): 'R [V8a] is best... stabilized thicker lines and softer screentone dots mimic professional manga inking (like Captain Tsubasa)... most polished' -> SHIP: R

selection.why: only config that passes every machine gate on BOTH the b8 fast-loop window and the failing b2 close-up (T4 1.4337%) while WINNING the full-resolution VLM visual arbitration (player identity + manga authenticity). The phase-1 winner v4 was honestly superseded after its b2 coverage-cell T4 failure - the full-render evidence set was re-produced from scratch with the final config.
selection.antiCrawlAudit: screen lattice screen-anchored (pixel-indexed, never content-fit); all thresholds/knees fixed constants; no temporal state; no per-frame RNG (grain texture generated once from seed 42); no frame-index dependence
